agreement_01.title: Customer Trading Agreement
agreement_01.section1: The terms and conditions comprised in this Agreement and the Application Form shall apply to and govern each Account opened or established with SFI and in respect of all Transactions in Commodity Market.
agreement_01.section2: In addition to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the following terms and conditions shall apply in the circumstances and/or Transactions described therein
agreement_01.section2_a: a. Rules and Regulation set forth by the Commodity Market Organiser
agreement_01.section2_b: b. Rules and Regulation set forth by the Clearing House
agreement_01.section2_d: d. Circular Letter issued by the Commodity Market Organizer and Clearing Institution
agreement_01.section2_e: e. Any other additional or specific terms set forth by SFI in respect of that Account or Transaction
agreement_01.section3: In these Customer Trading Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the meanings respectively hereafter assigned to them:

definition.Account: An account opened and maintained with SFI on which the Customer effects Transactions pursuant to this Agreement
definition.Agreement: This Trading Customer Agreement (as may from time to time be varied, modified or supplemented in accordance with   its provisions), and includes its Schedules, the Appendix and all other documents or instruments made supplemental to it, including but not limited to the Application Form(s)
definition.Applicable Laws: all relevant or applicable laws, regulations, notices, guidelines, circulars, orders, bye-laws, rulings, practice notes and interpretations or such other documents as may be promulgated by the relevant governmental or regulatory body under which SFI is regulated
definition.Applicable Form: The application form by which the Customer applies to SFI to open an account with SFI
definition.Commodity Market Organiser: A Commodity Market Organiser in Indonesia that provides the trading of commodity through an electronic trading platform
definition.Business Day: Any day on which SFI is open for business in Indonesia
definition.Circulars: Rules issued by the CommodityMarket Organiser and the ClearingHouse
definition.Clearing House: A clearing and guarantee institution which SFI registered as a Clearing Member to clear the transaction in the Commodity Market Organiser
definition.Commodity: Any produce, item or good in such commodity, that is the subject of any Transaction, and may include without limitation, to agriculture products, mining products or otherwise
definition.Confirmation: The written notice (whether in telex, facsimile, or other electronic form) which contains the specific terms of a Transaction and which includes a contract note. The notice may include details such as the purchase or sale, the delivery month of the commodity and the price transacted
definition.Contract Specification: Specification of the commodity and the tradingterms set forthby the Commodity Market Organiser
definition.Customer: Entity named in the Application Form as the applicant(s) for the Account and whose application for the Account has been approved, and includes the successors in title of the Customer
definition.Customer Segregated Account: A bank account owned by SFI for the purpose to keep customer’s fund segregated from SFI’s operational account
definition.Default: Have the meaning ascribedto it under Clause10
definition.Extraordinary Event: any event which SFI in good faith believes to have a material effect on any Transaction and shall includewithout limitation any form of the Commodity Market control restriction or requirement of whatsoever nature affecting the availability, convertibility, credit or transfers of currencies, financial instruments or funds, any form of debt or other moratorium on jurisdictions, individuals or entities, any devaluation, redenomination or denomination of the underlying   currencies   or   financial   instruments   of any Transaction and/or any form of restriction or requirement which in SFI"s good faith opinion adversely alters or changes the rights or obligations which SFI in good faith undertook upon the establishment of such Transaction
definition.FATCA: the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act provisions of the U.S. Internal Revenue Service under Sections 1471 to 1474 of the Code or any associated treasury regulations, as amended or supplemented from time to time, or other official guidance any treaty, law, regulation or other official guidance enacted in any other jurisdiction, or relating to an intergovernmental agreement between the U.S. and any other jurisdiction
definition.Guarantee: Any form of fund placed by the Customer to guarantee theirtransaction
definition.Loss: All or any claims, liabilities, losses, damages, costs, charges and/or expenses of whatsoever nature and howsoever arising, incurred or suffered, including legal costs on a full indemnity basis, cost of funding and loss or cost incurred as a result of the terminating, liquidating or re-establishment of any hedge or related trading position
definition.Order: Any authorisation, request, instruction or order (in whatever form and howsoever sent) given   or    transmitted to    SFI   by the Customer or which SFI reasonably believes to be the authorisation, request, instruction or order of the Customer in relation to an Account or in respect of a Transaction, and includes any authorisation, request, instruction or order to revoke, ignore or vary any previous authorisation, request, instruction or order
definition.Password: The unique code(s) used by the Customer to access any form of electronic communication in order to receive any communication from SFI and/or communicate or convey with or to SFI, including without limitation, Orders or any other communication
definition.Personal Data: Whether true or not, about an individual who can be identified (a) from that data; or (b) from that data and other information to which an organisation has or is likely to have access
definition.Commodity Delivery: Settlement method of the transaction at the Commodity Market where Seller will have to deliver their commodity to Buyer
definition.Potential Default: Any event or circumstance which, with the giving of notice or the lapse of time or both, would constitute a Default
definition.Rules and Regulation: all relevant or applicable laws, regulations, notices, guidelines, circulars, orders, bye-laws, rulings, practice notes and interpretations or such other documents as may be promulgated by the Commodity Market Organiser and its Clearing House
definition.SFI: Straits Financial Indonesia and includes any successors in title to SFI and where relevant, its assigns
definition.Statement: Transaction report issued by SFI to Customer in daily and monthly basis
definition.Transaction: Any transaction in respect of any  Commodity or such other transactions as SFI may from time to time permit to be carried out under any Account
definition.Transaction Guarantee: Any transaction in respect of any  Commodity or such other transactions as SFI may from time to time permit to be carried out under any Account
definition.Username: login identification which may be used by the Customer to access any form of electronic communication in order to receive any communication from SFI and/or communicate or convey with or to SFI, including without limitation, Orders or any other communication
definition.Variation Guarantee: An additional funds made by the Customers due to the equity of the account falls below as required

agreement_02.title: Order Instructions and Execution
agreement_02.subtitle: Methods by which a customer may place orders with SFI
agreement_02.section1: The Customer may instruct SFI to execute any Transaction for an Account by placing an Order with SFI through one of the following methods:
agreement_02.section1_a: a. Telephone to the SFI office number, as may be amended from time to time
agreement_02.section1_b: b. Internet messaging or other electronic transmission methods as approved by SFI;
agreement_02.section1_c: c. E-mail to official SFI e-mail address, as may be amended from time to time
agreement_02.section1_d: d. Any other medium or in such manner as SFI may in its sole discretion approve, but always in accordance with the rules and practices of the relevant Commodity Market.
agreement_02.section2: SFI shall only act on Orders in respect of any Account when Guarantee is available and sufficiently adequate as determined by the amount of Guarantee actually placed by Customer in SFI's Customer Segregated Account. Notwithstanding the foregoing, SFI is not obliged to enter into any Transaction with the Customer or to accept any Order and may refuse to do so without giving any reason. SFI shall bear no liability for failing to comply with any Order of the Customer.
agreement_02.section3: Customer acknowledges that SFI acts as agent to Customer in respect of all Transactions, except where SFI discloses otherwise. Notwithstanding the above, SFI may, in its sole and absolute discretion, assume the role of either principal or counterparty for SFI's own account or for the accounts of persons associated with SFI and Customer waives any and all prior notice required by SFI in respect of such transactions. In such circumstances, SFI and/or its associated companies are entitled to all gains, profits and benefits derived from such transactions.
agreement_02.section4: The Customer is expected to monitor its Transactions and comply with all Guarantee Requirements and understand the Contract Specification. SFI shall not be under any obligation to review the status of the Customer's Account for compliance with all Guarantee requirements. Notwithstanding this, SFI may, in its sole and absolute discretion, review the status of a Customer's Account for the purposes of ensuring compliance with any applicable Guarantee requirements provided that SFI shall bear no liability whatsoever for any such review.
agreement_02.section5: In the event that the Customer wishes to authorise a person to place Order, such authorisation shall be submitted together with the account application form. SFI shall be entitled, but not obliged, to verify and be satisfied with respect to the identity of the person purporting to give an Order on behalf of the Customer or the source and origin of such Order and SFI may refuse to rely or act upon any such Order unless and until SFI is satisfied as to the matters on which SFI sought verification.
agreement_02.section6: Once an Order is received by SFI, such Order is binding upon the Customer provided that the Customer may give an Order to withdraw, cancel, revoke or vary a previous Order.
agreement_02.section7: Where a Customer instructs SFI to withdraw, cancel, revoke or vary an Order, SFI shall not be obliged to comply with such instructions until after it has been confirmed that the Order has not been executed.
agreement_02.section8: The Customer acknowledges that subsequent Orders to revoke or cancel an earlier Order given may not be effective to revoke an earlier Order or to cancel an Order made earlier. In such an event, SFI shall not be liable to the Customer.
agreement_02.section9: In the event that SFI decides to act on any Order or is otherwise under an obligation to act on any Order, SFI shall be allowed such amount of time to act and implement any Order as may be reasonable having regard to the systems and operations of SFI and any other circumstances then prevailing and shall not be liable for any Loss arising from any delay on the part of SFI in acting on any such Order.
agreement_02.section10: Where any Order is ambiguous or inconsistent with any other Order, SFI shall clarify with Customer on the Order to be placed, and if the Order remains ambiguous and inconsistent SFI shall be entitled to rely and act upon any Order in accordance with any reasonable interpretation thereof which SFI believes in good faith to be the correct interpretation and SFI shall not be liable for any results of any actions taken in good faith pertaining to such Order.

agreement_03.title: Transaction Limits and Restrictions
agreement_03.section1: SFI may, in its sole and absolute discretion at any time and without prior notice to the Customer, impose upon the Customer or vary any position or transaction limits, or any trading or transaction restrictions. Such limits may include minimum or maximum sizes for Transactions, specified times or procedures for communicating Orders to SFI or otherwise.
agreement_03.section2: All cash and other property of the Customer (including, but not limited to, Guarantee) which may at times be in SFI's (or any of SFI's Affiliate's) possession or control or carried on SFI's books for the Customer either solely, jointly with others, or as a guarantor for the account of any person, for any purpose, including safekeeping, are to be held by SFI (or any of SFI's Affiliate's) as continuing security and subject to a general lien and right of set off for liabilities of the Customer to SFI or any of SFI's Affiliates whether or not SFI has made advances in connection with such cash or other property, and irrespective of the number of Accounts the Customer may have with SFI.
agreement_03.section3: SFI is hereby authorised to sell and/or purchase, or otherwise apply, any and all such cash and other property without notice to the Customer to satisfy any liabilities owing to SFI or SFI's Affiliate.
agreement_03.section4: SFI may in its discretion, at any time and from time to time, without notice to the Customer apply and/or transfer any or all such cash and other property of the Customer's interchangeably between any of the Customer's Accounts. SFI shall be entitled at any time without notice to combine and/or consolidate all or any of the Customer's Accounts with SFI and SFI's Affiliates without being obliged to furnish any reason to the Customer. Without limiting or modifying the general provisions of this Agreement, SFI is hereby specifically authorised to transfer any sum or sums among the different Accounts that the Customer has with SFI and with any of SFI's Affiliates in settlement of all the Customer's debts with SFI or SFI's Affiliates.
agreement_03.section5: For so long as the Customer owes moneys or obligations (of whatsoever nature and howsoever arising) to SFI, the Customer may not withdraw any cash or other property held with SFI (whether as Guarantee or otherwise) without SFI's consent. SFI may at any time withhold any cash or other property of the Customer pending full settlement of all such moneys or obligations of the Customer.

agreement_04.clause_1: SFI shall, where applicable furnish to the Customer a Confirmation, Daily Statement and any call for additional Variation Guarantee in respect of such Transaction, in such manner and at such time in which SFI in its sole discretion shall determine.
agreement_04.clause_2: SFI shall endeavor to issue such statements referred in Clause 4.1 no later than one (1) Business Day after any Transaction. Should there be any disruption or delay in issuing of Confirmation, daily statement or calls of additional Variation Guarantee, SFI shall endeavor, within commercially reasonable means, to resolve such delay as soon as possible.
agreement_04.clause_3: If the Customer does not receive a Confirmation or Statement in the ordinary course of business, the Customer shall immediately notify SFI of such fact.
agreement_04.clause_4: The Customer shall verify all Confirmations and Statements sent by SFI to the Customer. If no objection is raised within one (1) Business Day of the Customer's receipt of such Confirmation or Statement, such Confirmation or Statement shall, except for manifest or clerical errors, be deemed conclusive and binding upon the Customer, who shall not be entitled to object thereto and who shall be deemed to have ratified all matters therein stated. Any objection raised by the Customer shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence supporting the alleged inaccuracy and shall be communicated to SFI.
agreement_04.clause_5: SFI may at any time rectify any error on any entry, Statement, Confirmation or advice which has been proved to its satisfaction, and may demand immediate repayment from the Customer of any monies erroneously paid over to the Customer as a result of such error.

agreement_05.clause_1: The Customer shall deposit in each Account and/or otherwise provide SFI with Transaction Guarantee deposits in such amounts determined by SFI prior to the execution of each Transaction.
agreement_05.clause_2: Customer shall maintain and meet the required Variation Guarantee requirement at all times as SFI may in its sole and absolute discretion stipulate.
agreement_05.clause_3: SFI may, in its sole and absolute discretion, with or without notice to the Customer, vary its Guarantee requirements, levels, and other requirements for each Account at any time, and may also stipulate that such revised Guarantee requirements shall apply to existing positions as well as new positions in respect of the Transactions or Accounts. The Customer agrees that SFI may, by notice, effect an immediate change in Transaction Guarantee requirements and/or require with or without prior notice additional Variation Guarantee to be deposited immediately or within a very short period of time which may be less than twenty-four (24) hours. The Customer hereby waives any right to object on the grounds that such requirement is unreasonable. No previous Guarantee requirements shall set a precedent or bind SFI. The Customer accepts that this is a risk inherent in the Customer's entering into and dealing in Transactions with or through SFI.
agreement_05.clause_4: The Customer does not have a right to an extension of time with regards to calls for additional Variation Guarantee or new Guarantee by SFI. If SFI, in its sole and absolute discretion grants any such extension of time for calls for Variation Guarantee to the Customer, then unless SFI expressly states in writing that such extension of time is intended to override or prevail over SFI's rights under Clause 5, such an extension of time is not binding and shall be deemed to have been granted subject always to SFI's rights under this Clause 5.
agreement_05.clause_5: The Customer acknowledges and agrees that no interest shall be paid on any type of Guarantee deposited, maintained, and/or otherwise provided by or for the Customer with SFI and that any interest earned on the Customer's Guarantee may be retained by SFI for SFI's own account and benefit. SFI shall be entitled to charge interest on any sum due from the Customer in respect of any Guarantee requirements at such rate and calculated and/or compounded in such manner as SFI may impose and determine from time to time in its sole and absolute discretion.
agreement_05.clause_6: SFI may, at any time and in its sole and absolute discretion, apply and/or set off (whether by way of sale, disposal, or otherwise) any and all Guarantee held by SFI and/or any of SFI's Affiliates towards the payment of any amounts due and payable by the Customer to SFI under any Transaction or Account or towards meeting any of the Customer's obligations and liabilities to SFI (whether or not arising out of this Agreement and including but not limited to the obligation to comply with the Transaction Guarantee and the obligation to provide additional Variation Guarantee), whether or not any time which has been allowed for the Customer to provide any additional Variation Guarantee or take any other action has elapsed. agreement_10.clause_3_a: Suspend (indefinitely or otherwise) or terminate any Account, or SFI's relationship with the Customer and accelerate any and all liabilities of the Customer to SFI so that they shall become immediately due and payable;

riskDisclosureStatement.sectionHeader: RISK DISCLOSURE STATEMENT FOR TRANSACTION IN COMMODITY MARKET
riskDisclosureStatement.introText: The intention of this statement is to inform you that the risk of loss in trading in commodity contracts can be substantial. You should therefore carefully consider whether such trading is suitable for you in light of your financial condition.
riskDisclosureStatement.consideration: In considering whether to trade, you should be aware of the following:
riskDisclosureStatement.guaranteeDetail: You may sustain a total loss of the guarantee and any additional variation guarantee that you deposit to establish a position or maintain positions in the commodity market. If the market moves against your positions, you may be called upon to deposit a substantial amount of additional guarantee, on short notice, in order to maintain your positions. If you do not provide the required guarantee within the prescribed time, your positions may be liquidated at a loss, and you will be liable for any resulting deficit in your account.
riskDisclosureStatement.liquidationOfPositionDetail: Under certain market conditions, you may find it difficult or impossible to liquidate a position.
riskDisclosureStatement.contingentOrdersDetail: Placing contingent orders, such as 'stop-loss' or 'stop-limit' order (as may or may not be offered to you from time to time), will not necessarily limit your losses to the intended amounts, since market conditions may make it impossible to execute such orders.
riskDisclosureStatement.spreadPositionDetail: A 'spread' position may (as may or may not be offered to you from time to time) not be less risky than a simple 'long' or 'short' position.
riskDisclosureStatement.leverageDetail: The high degree of leverage that is often obtainable, trading in commodity contracts because of the small guarantee requirements can work against you as well as for you. The use of leverage can lead to large losses as well as gains.
riskDisclosureStatement.foreignMarketTransactionsDetail: Funds placed with a commodity broker for the purpose of participating in foreign markets may not enjoy the same level of protection of funds placed in commodity markets located in Indonesia.
riskDisclosureStatement.disclosureStatement: This brief statement cannot disclose all the risks and other significant aspects of the commodity market. You should therefore carefully study trading in commodity contracts trading before you trade.
